title: Your guide asks three questions at a jaunt's end
items: Check your understanding now asks three questions with real answers: where on the walk you heard something, how sure we can be of it, and which source it came from.
Every choice is a real stop, grade or source from that jaunt. Try again as often as you like, or ask to be shown the answer after two tries.
Nothing is scored or saved. Your own-words reflection is still there beneath each question.
